discovery.title: Discovered dLight lamps
discovery.description: Select a discovered lamp to add, or choose manual entry.

data_description.ip_address: The lamp's IPv4 address on your local network.
data_description.device_id: Printed on the lamp's label, or shown in the dLight app.
data_description.name: Optional friendly name. Defaults to the device model.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure dLight
reconfigure.description: Update the connection details for this lamp.

data_description.ip_address: Update this if your router assigned the lamp a new address.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the lamp. Check the IP address and device ID, and make sure the lamp is powered.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the Home Assistant logs for details.

abort.already_configured: This lamp is already configured. Its stored IP address has been refreshed.
abort.unique_id_mismatch: That device ID belongs to a different lamp. Reconfigure can only update this entry's lamp.

turn_on_failed.message: Failed to turn on {device_name}. Device reported: {error}

turn_off_failed.message: Failed to turn off {device_name}. Device reported: {error}
